imagery: Educational diagram comparing activation function shapes: step functions, sigmoid, tanh, and arctan. Yellow highlight ellipses on step graphs appear decorative/unlabeled.
typography_notes: Single sans-serif family throughout. Hierarchy: title (large, red, centered) > section labels (red, equation titles) > body text (black/dark). Condition text in red italic, possibly below 11px. All-caps 'Unit Step' vs sentence-case elsewhere creates inconsistency. Chart titles: 'f(x) = ...' notation for sigmoid/tanh vs title case 'Inverse Tangent Graph' for arctan.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide size to 13.33x7.5 in (16:9) and fill the page background with #1a1a1a.
2. Add a full-slide rounded-rectangle outer frame inset 0.15 in from all edges; fill #f5f5f5, border 1pt #cccccc.
3. Place the title text "Saturation Problem in Activation Functions" at top-center (y≈0.28 in), large sans-serif, color #d00000, horizontally centered.
4. Place a yellow circular badge with text "18" at top-right (≈12.48, 0.30 in); fill #fff9c4, outline #fff9c4, text #333333, flush against the frame corner.
5. Top-left equation card: render "F(x) = Uni-polar Unit Step" in red #d00000 on #f5f5f5, with the piecewise condition "for x<0" in smaller red italic #d00000 beneath it.
6. Top-left graph card: draw a bordered pane below the equation containing the uni-polar step function chart; axes #333333, grid #cccccc, curve #0066cc, and exactly two yellow ellipses #fff9c4 highlighting the flat branches.
7. Top-right equation card: render "F(x) = Bi-polar Unit Step" in red #d00000 on #f5f5f5, with the piecewise condition "for x≥0" in smaller red italic #d00000 beneath it.
8. Top-right graph card: draw a bordered pane below the equation containing the bi-polar step function chart; axes #333333, grid #cccccc, curve #0066cc, and exactly two yellow ellipses #fff9c4 highlighting the flat branches.
9. Center callout: place a bordered box between the two top columns titled "Saturation Problem" in red #d00000, with body text "Same Output value for Different input values" in #333333; widen the box so the body wraps to no more than 3 lines.
10. Bottom-left chart: bordered pane with sigmoid curve titled "f(x) = Sigmoid(x)"; axes #333333, grid #cccccc, curve #0066cc, legend box #ffffff at top-left inside the plot area.
11. Bottom-center chart: bordered pane with tanh curve titled "f(x) = tanh(x)"; axes #333333, grid #cccccc, curve #0066cc; remove any stray minus-only tick label on the y-axis.
12. Bottom-right chart: bordered pane with arctan curve titled "Inverse Tangent Graph" and subtitle "f(x) = tan⁻¹(x)"; axes #333333, grid #cccccc, curve #0066cc.
13. Draw dashed red connectors #d00000 from the bottom edge of both top step-graph cards down to the top edge of the three bottom charts; terminate near chart top edges without pointing at specific elements.
14. Add a full-width black strip #000000 along the very bottom edge of the slide.
15. Apply consistent card styling across all panes: thin light borders #cccccc, rounded corners, and uniform padding.
